shell.music.sort.name: Name
shell.music.no_song_sub: Import a .mid file to get started
shell.music.admin_hint: The game doesn't receive the keys? Restart DodoTopia as administrator.
shell.music.transpose_hint: Shifts the notes down or up, in semitones, on top of the automatic transposition.
shell.discover.title: Discover songs
shell.discover.sort.title: Title
shell.together.intro: Two ways to start the same song at the same moment. Everyone keeps their own instrument.
shell.together.room_sub: A six-character code brings the players together; the host gives the go through the server.
shell.together.audio_sub: No network needed. The first player plays a cue note in the game, the others detect it and start with them.
shell.together.calib_title: All together: the leader plays their pattern, everyone answers, each player's offset is measured and saved
shell.together.offset_hint: Negative value: you play earlier than the others. Positive value: you play later.
shell.offset.meaning: {dir, select, early {plays earlier} late {plays later} other {no offset}}
shell.draw.title: Draw an image in Heartopia
shell.draw.no_image_sub: Import an image to see how it will look in the game
shell.draw.empty_title: Import an image, DodoTopia paints it cell by cell
shell.draw.empty_text: Pick a photo or a drawing: it is converted to the colours of Heartopia's palette, then reproduced in the game's drawing tool.
shell.draw.formats_hint: Accepted formats: .png, .jpg, .gif, .bmp, .webp — or drop the file here.
shell.draw.preview_empty:
The cell-by-cell preview of the drawing
will appear here.
shell.draw.frame_reset: Reset the format and framing to their defaults
shell.draw.colors_reset: Reset the colours to their defaults
shell.draw.grid_hint: Draws the cell borders in the preview beside. Doesn't change the drawing made in the game.
shell.draw.dither_hint: Mixes two neighbouring colours cell by cell to imitate a shade the palette lacks. The result looks smoother from afar, grainier up close.
shell.draw.outline: Pencil outlines, then fill with the paint bucket
shell.draw.fill_bg: Fill the background with the bucket before drawing
shell.draw.advanced_hint: Delays, verification and the number of cells per format are in Settings › Drawing and setup.
shell.cook.title: Automatic cooking
shell.cook.headline: Cook the last recipe on a loop
shell.cook.sub: Set up, then start the loop in front of the stove
shell.cook.recapture_title: Recapture only the three bubble icons (cook, spatula with green ring, gloves)
shell.cook.config_hint: The setup remembers the bubble area, its icons, the last recipe tile, the Cook button and a patch of grass. Redo it if you change screen or resolution.
shell.cook.how: What DodoTopia does during the loop
shell.cook.how2: Recipes menu: first recent tile, then Cook
shell.cook.how3: While cooking: clicks the spatula as soon as the green ring appears
shell.cook.how4: Collects the dish, closes the upgraded-dish animation
shell.cook.how5: Repeats, until the wanted number of dishes or until stopped
shell.calib.title: Set up the game area
shell.calib.key_hint: Place the mouse on the target in Heartopia, then press F3.
shell.calib.waiting: Waiting: the position hasn't been saved yet.
shell.inst.title: Choose my instrument
shell.inst.help: Choose the instrument you have open in Heartopia.
shell.inst.warn: Choosing here doesn't equip the instrument in Heartopia: open the right instrument in the game too.
shell.inst.search_ph: French or English name, or nickname…
shell.wiz.title: Set up the keys
shell.gallery.title: Drawing gallery
shell.gallery.intro: Drawings shared by players. “Reproduce” loads the cell grid into your Drawing activity, ready to paint in Heartopia.
